title: Interpret my cards
description: Choose a spread, enter your cards and explore their meanings. Save a reflection on this browser or export it.
homeLead: Find meanings, learn spreads and connect the cards you drew. Start here with free reference tools; AI readings belong to the companion app.
searchHint: Try “Queen of Cups reversed”, “coins” or a keyword.
empty: No matching cards. Try a shorter name or clear the filters.
question: Your question (optional)
practiceHint: These are reference meanings and practice prompts, not an AI reading. Your interpretation may differ.
connectionPrompt: Compare {first} and {second}: where do their themes support or challenge each other? Use the position labels to explore another possible reading.
positionPrompt: In “{position}”, how could this meaning change? What detail in the picture supports your interpretation?
storageNote: One saved reflection; saving again replaces it. Saved only in this browser on this device, not synced to your account. Browser data can be cleared. Export a copy to keep it.
storageError: Could not save in this browser. Keep this tab open and export your reflection.
invalid: No valid saved reflection could be loaded. Your current cards are unchanged.
deleted: Saved reflection deleted from this browser.
copyError: Copy failed. Export the text instead.
exported: Text exported. Keep the file somewhere safe.
aiNote: AI readings are not connected on this website yet. No question or card selection is sent to an AI service here, and no credits are used. You can use all the reference and practice tools below.
diagramHint: Place the cards in numbered order. The labels below explain their roles; future positions describe possibilities, not promises.
exampleQuestion: How can I make time for a creative project?
exampleThree: The Magician suggests an earlier spark; the Two of Pentacles brings attention to competing demands now; the Eight of Pentacles suggests a possible direction through steady practice. The positions turn three definitions into a developing story.
exampleDecision: The Magician in the situation highlights resources; the Two of Pentacles in the challenge highlights divided attention; the Eight of Pentacles as a way forward suggests a small repeatable practice. Another reading might emphasise learning a skill before expanding the project.
exampleCeltic: Start with the centre pair: the Magician as the heart and the Two of Pentacles crossing it can suggest available resources competing with other commitments. Compare the foundation and aim before reading the final direction. No single outcome card overrides the other positions.
astroLead: Explore zodiac correspondences and use them as prompts for a tarot practice.
astroNote: These are symbolic correspondences, not a personalised horoscope or a calculated birth chart. Traditions differ.
weeklyPrompt: An undated practice you can repeat: choose one theme from your sign’s card, use a three-card spread, then write what you notice. Revisit your notes after a week. This is not a weekly forecast.
astronomyNote: For factual explanations of the Moon and sky, visit NASA Science. This site does not calculate live moon phases, planetary positions or eclipse dates.
changeWarning: Changing the spread clears the current card positions. Export or save first if you want to keep this reading.
complete: Choose every card to complete the spread. Each card can appear once.
disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. Interpretations are possibilities, not predictions or professional advice.
replaceWarning: Replace the first card with this card? Your other cards and notes will stay.
